description: Audit specification for YT6 evaluation system: external review rules, required artefacts, and compliance checks.

dataset_integrity.description: Verify that all testcases have corresponding expected outputs and assertions.

engine_integrity.description: Verify that engine.json contains all required execution, signal, and stability fields.

grader_integrity.description: Verify that grader.json defines all signals and weights.

schema_integrity.description: Verify that schema.json defines all structural rules for evaluation artefacts.

results_completeness.description: Verify that every testcase has a corresponding result file and summary.json exists.

trace_completeness.description: Verify that each testcase has a trace file with required fields.

validation_pass.description: Verify that all validation checks pass with no missing artefacts.
